statements.t: Based on the guidance provided in accordance with ASC 280 Segment Reporting , the Company determined it has two reportable segments, leasing and direct patient services.
The amount the Company expects to receive is recorded as revenue and estimated based on historical experience.

The Company assesses recoverability of a long-lived asset by determining whether the carrying value of the asset group can be recovered through projected undiscounted cash flows over their remaining lives.
The Company’s expected primary cash needs on both a short and long-term basis are for capital expenditures, business expansion, working capital, and other general corporate purposes.

I f the Company is unable to negotiate an extension to the Credit Agreement beyond June 30, 2027, or refinance that debt obligation, the Company’s liquidity will be adversely impacted and the Company’s ability to satisfy all of its commitments over the next twelve months in accordance with their current terms would be jeopardized.

The Company has secured financing for its projects from several lenders and anticipates that it will be able to secure financing on future projects from these or other lending sources, but there can be no assurance that financing will continue to be available on acceptable terms.

As of September 30, 2026, the Company assessed the remaining milestone payments under ASC 450 Contingencies and concluded it is probable the next milestone payment due December 20, 2026, will be payable to Fifth Third.

The Company recognized the warrants under ASC 815 Derivatives and Hedging , as equity and the fair value of the warrants of $79,000 was recorded as a discount on the Note, which will be amortized through the Maturity Date.

The Esprit upgrades and one LINAC installation are anticipated to occur in approximately mid-2027 or later at existing customer sites and the Company’s future Gamma Knife site in Guadalajara, Mexico (San Javier).
There can be no assurance that financing will be available for the Company’s initiatives or future projects, or at terms that are acceptable to the Company.
However, the Company currently has cash on hand of $9,485,000 and is actively engaged with financing resources to fund these projects.
The Company believes that cash flow from cash on hand and operations will be sufficient to cover these payments.
